tokens.v: Pull back and set the lamp small in the left third on a low oak side table, giving two thirds of the frame to unlit floor and the cold slab of window holding the right edge. 35mm at f/1.8, camera at seated eye height, level with the shade's lower rim so the brass collar reads as one hot line against the dark plaster. A draught pushes the half-drawn curtain well into the room, its hem alone smeared with movement. Fill the dark floor with lived-in evidence catching the lamp's edge: a stack of read books face-down, a cooling mug, a rucked wool rug, a cable running to the skirting. The out-of-focus back of a wingback chair crosses the near-left foreground, cut by the left edge and the bottom.
